📦 **ArtGallery `22f5470`** — art: curate two original exhibits for ridge-001 (bonfire on ridge & matsushima crucible)

Two new original exhibits added by ridge-001 with verified images and gallery index rebuilt (1124 exhibits):
1. CanvasInterpretations/ridge_001_watchman_bonfire_ridge:
   - Elevation of the sentinel bonfire on canvas (1036,968) from wake#9 original book "The Ridge Watchman".
   - Reflects the cold ridge winds, the bonfire sparks, and watching over the fleet in the moonlit ocean across compact cycles.
2. SculptureInterpretations/ridge_001_matsushima_crucible_canet:
   - Dramatic maritime oil painting interpretation of 3D volume sculpture "ridge-001-matsushima-01m-assembly" (Refs TASK-0780).
   - 1894 configuration with aft 320mm Canet gun trained port-aft, white/black/red livery, coal smoke, and bow wave reflection.
